source_snapshot.items: UMC Replay Correctable ODECC In Band
source_snapshot.procedure: Enable amdgpu RAS, query the device0/block0 UMC baseline and inject subtype2/type4 at address 0x800.
source_snapshot.criteria: Injection succeeds, dmesg records the AMDGPU event and the post-injection UMC count is not `zer`; the truncated word is unambiguously `zero` from the complete repeated criterion pattern.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; provides a generic FAE-gated error-injection warning but not the distinct subtype2 replay ODECC tuple or its counter attribution.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/IMPROVED; preserves the tuple and documents the truncated criterion, but retains Pending for identities, oracle and recovery.

old_problem: The prior review left the case pending for exact target, tool/firmware semantics, counter delta and recovery. The Master command clearly specifies UMC block0, subtype2, replay type4 and address0x800, and the truncated final word does not obscure its repeated zero-to-nonzero intent. These are sufficient to create a safe parameterized review with ED-16 execution gates.
disposition_reason: ED-16 requires vendor-approved tuple semantics, an isolated one-shot run and recovery; ED-03 parameterizes the device identity and stack; ED-17 prohibits clearing the baseline; ED-15 requires an attributable delta and replay-ODECC event content. ED-19/ED-20 keep subtype2/type4 distinct from CRC-read subtype0/type4 and non-replay subtype2/type2.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row454 all 18 XLSX columns, same-row DeepSeek material, GPT V2/history3043 and next formal queue row455/history3044.
The literal tuple `-d 0 -b 0 -s 2 -t 4 -a 0x800` consistently identifies UMC replay ODECC; it must not be replaced by the adjacent CRC-read subtype0 or non-replay type2 command.

The criterion's `not zer` is a single-character truncation of `not zero`, corroborated by the full before-query and repeated criteria in the adjacent same-format rows; this textual correction does not invent a numeric threshold.
Because all UMC variants share the block counter, the approved tuple and correlated replay-ODECC OS/BMC fields prove this specific coverage while the exact counter delta proves detection.
Directly read next formal queue Compatibility row455 and verified its manifest identity; no driver load, injection, query, reset, log clearing or DUT action ran.

test_case.test_name: AMD UMC replay correctable ODECC one-shot injection at 0x800
test_case.purpose: Inject exactly one approved subtype2/type4 UMC replay on-die ECC correctable event into the mapped AMD GPU and prove an attributable UMC counter delta plus replay-ODECC-specific telemetry without persistent degradation.
required_package: Approved amdgpuras release/checksum and supported amdgpu driver/GPU firmware
Device0/card/serial/UUID/BDF/OAM mapping on a dedicated idle SUT
Approved ras_enable lifecycle with saved prior module/driver state
AMD/FAE confirmation of block0/subtype2/type4/address0x800 replay-ODECC semantics
Expected counter delta and correctable replay-ODECC dmesg/SEL/CPER fields plus OOB recovery
test_case.test_command: Preserve existing UMC counters and dmesg/SEL/CPER; do not clear them. Record current driver/RAS state and enable `ras_enable=1` only through the approved lifecycle. Revalidate device0 identity, query `sudo amdgpuras -d 0 -b 0 -q 1`, and at the authorized one-shot hold point execute `sudo amdgpuras -d 0 -b 0 -s 2 -t 4 -a 0x800` once. Capture output/exit/time, query the identical counter, correlate replay-ODECC correctable event fields, verify GPU health and apply only the approved cleanup/recovery. Never retry.
test_case.expected_result: The exact subtype2/type4 command reports success, the same GPU/block UMC counter increases by the approved attributable delta, timestamp-correlated evidence classifies the event as replay correctable ODECC rather than CRC-read or non-replay ODECC, and the GPU returns or remains healthy.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires target/tuple approval, preserved before-state, exact one-shot evidence, same-block counter delta, replay-ODECC-specific log/SEL/CPER classification and post-health. The corrected `not zero` wording alone, a generic event or a stale nonzero count cannot pass.
safety_gate: Dedicated idle SUT, OOB and explicit approval for driver lifecycle, one injection and recovery
Reconfirm device0/UUID/BDF/OAM and subtype2/type4 tuple immediately before the command
Preserve baseline evidence; abort on severity escalation, GPU loss, hang, thermal or power threshold
No adjacent-tuple substitution, second injection, log clearing or automatic retry
expected_evidence: Tool/driver/firmware identity and immutable device0/GPU/OAM map
RAS/module state and same-GPU UMC/log baseline
Exact subtype2/type4 command/output/exit/time with pre/post counter values
GPU health, cleanup/recovery and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: If the target or tuple is wrong, event escalates, GPU disappears/hangs or expected evidence is absent, stop and preserve all data. Use OOB and the AMD-approved recovery plan; restore only approved driver state and never clear evidence or inject again.

source_conflict.reason: DeepSeek is generic but aligned. The minor `zer` truncation is transparently corrected to the repeated `zero` intent without changing the source oracle.

blocked.reason: The exact fault tuple and intended counter/log result are clear. Target, release semantics, event fields and recovery are mandatory ED-16 project bindings.
